description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Hospital Emergency Operations Activation: Disaster or Steady State Function? is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Leremy Colf, University of Oklahoma-Health Sciences Center (ouhsc.edu). Hospitals and emergency departments provide essential critical care during disasters and must be prepared to activate the Emergency Operations Plan (EOP) during significant patient surge events. We evaluate historical storm events correlated with emergency department visit data to determine appropriateness of recommended EOP activation triggers. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-frkm-mg36. Keywords: NHERI, Hospital Emergency Operations, Emergency Operations Plan, EOP, Storm Events. Published 2024-07-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
